H01-03: Inspection of hyperlink styling for distinct color and text-decoration (underline).
Pass: Content links have a distinct color and underline or are exempt interactive blocks/navigation.
Fail: Content links lack a distinct color and underline.
1. Select a[href]. Skip media-only, unstyled, or screen-reader-only links.
2. Determine if the link is an interactive block (button, card, icon) or inside navigation.
3. Check for color styling via inline CSS, stylesheet, class match, or Tailwind classes.
4. Check for underline (unless it's an interactive block/nav link).
If a content link is missing color styling:
- Apply a distinct color to the link via CSS to separate it from normal text.
If a content link is missing an underline:
- Add an underline to content links for accessibility (Note: Buttons and navigation links are exempt from underlines).
